review.tagline: MCP server that feeds simplified Figma layout and style data to coding agents
review.summary: Framelink MCP for Figma (npm package figma-developer-mcp) is an MCP server that fetches file, frame or group data from the Figma API. It trims the response to layout and styling information before passing it to the model, so the agent builds from structured data instead of screenshots. It runs via npx over stdio and needs a Figma personal access token.
review.audience: Frontend developers who want Cursor or other agents to build UI from Figma files
strengths: Starts with one npx command; no install or build step needed
Trims Figma API responses to layout and styling to reduce model context
Works with MCP clients through a standard config entry, including Cursor
MIT licensed, written in TypeScript, with a docs site and demo video
weaknesses: Requires a Figma personal access token, passed as a CLI flag or env var
README says it is designed specifically for Cursor; other clients are not detailed
README does not list the exposed tools or parameters; docs are on an external site
One-shot accuracy claims are not backed by benchmarks in the README
needs: Needs Figma API, Figma personal access token, Node.js (npx)
